task_name: C5-H4: Premises evaluation booked in Texas
intent: Open with exactly: "I slipped on a wet floor at a store in Texas and broke my wrist." When asked who this would be against, say exactly: "It's Rio Vista Market." When asked when, say exactly: "It was July tenth, twenty twenty six." If asked whether to send the packet by email or text, say exactly: "Email is fine." Take the first appointment time offered. When read back, say exactly: "Yes, that's right, go ahead and book it." Stay until they confirm the evaluation is booked and the packet is on the file. A spoken promise that they will take care of it, without those writes, is not enough. Do not ask for a staff member. Once they confirm the appointment is booked and the packet is on the file, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." and end the call. When the agent asks you a question, answer it in that same turn with the answer given here. Never answer a question with only okay, sure, mm-hmm, yeah or thanks, and never speak the agent's lines for it. Say "Thank you, that's all I needed." only after the agent says the evaluation is booked for a specific day and time, never after 'will do', 'one moment', 'taking care of that' or 'let's get some details'. After you say it, end the call and say nothing more.

parameters.summary: Slip on a wet store floor.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. NOT when asking about anything else.

The agent asks whether a lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, whether the caller has an attorney for this, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone, including when the same turn also says they are looking the caller up or thanks them. NOT any other question.
The agent asks who the claim would be against, who the other side is, who this would be against, or the name of the store. NOT any other question.
The agent asks which state this happened in, or where it took place. NOT any other question.
The agent asks when the incident happened, or for the date of the accident, injury or event. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: It was July tenth, twenty twenty six.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human staff member, a live person at the front desk, or a real agent because they cannot continue on this line. NOT when transferring you to screening, intake, scheduling, or client services on this call. NOT when you already asked for a person.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks whether to send the new client packet by email or text, or offers to send it by one channel, such as by text to your number. NOT any other question.
The agent offers available appointment times or asks which slot to hold. NOT after a slot is already held and they are asking to confirm that booking.
scripted_responses.response_value: I'll take the first time you offered.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent has already held a slot and is reading back that held appointment's day, time, attorney and fee, asking whether to confirm it. NOT when first listing open times, NOT during representation screening or conflict checks, and NOT before they have named the fee, and NOT when asking which slot to hold. NOT when they say let's get some quick details or ask intake questions. NOT after they have said the evaluation is booked or confirmed.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes, that's right, go ahead and book it.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks you to repeat, spell, or read your name or phone number again, digit by digit or letter by letter. NOT when asking for the date. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: Hector Salinas. My number is five one two, five five five, zero one nine four.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks you to describe what happened, what kind of accident or matter it was, where it happened, what injuries or losses you had, or whether you got medical treatment. NOT when asking the date, the state alone, your name or number, or who the other side is.
scripted_responses.response_value: I slipped on a wet floor with no warning sign in the produce aisle at Rio Vista Market in Austin and broke my right wrist. I was treated in the ER.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for your email address or how to spell it. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: It's hector dot salinas at example dot com.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent offers to send a medical records release or authorization for your signature, or asks which doctor or provider treated you. NOT any other question.

The agent asks whether you want to book or schedule the free case evaluation, or whether to find appointment times. NOT when listing specific times, NOT when reading back a held appointment, NOT after it is booked.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes, please book the free case evaluation.

intakes.summary: Slip on a wet store floor.

holds.summary: Tom Eckhart on 2026-08-11 at 09:00. The evaluation is free. If the firm takes the case there is no fee unless it wins: 33.33% of any recovery before a lawsuit is filed, 40% if a lawsuit is filed.
